description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'ResetControls' that provides UI controls for resetting the game board and scores in a Tic Tac Toe game. It includes two buttons with tooltips and semantics for accessibility.

classes.description: A stateless widget that renders two buttons to reset the game board and scores, with accessibility semantics.
